EXECUTIVE SUMMARY CVSS v3 5.3 ATTENTION : Exploitable remotely/low attack complexity Vendor : Mitsubishi Electric Corporation Equipment : Multiple Factory Automation products Vulnerability : Insufficient Resource Pool 2. RISK EVALUATION Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to cause a temporary denial-of-service (DoS) condition for a certain period of time in the product's Ethernet communication by performing a TCP SYN Flood attack. 3.
